Not long after your brief encounter at the library, Mornye sends you another invitation. The message is a word-for-word replica of her last one. It seems she is attempting to recreate your previous meeting to validate a specific theory.\nHead to the library to meet Mornye and assist with her experiment.

Mornye has sent you another invitation. Unlike your previous meetings, she has carefully selected a location designed for relaxation: "Lush vegetation and an open view." Can she obtain the experimental results she seeks in this new environment?\nHead to the Golden Spiral and meet Mornye.

After some careful preparation, it is your turn to send an invitation to Mornye. Upon receiving it, she seems a bit nervous—she doesn't have much experience simply "hanging out" with others. As her Mentor, this is your moment to lead the way.\nHead to the screening room with Mornye to watch the film you specially selected for her.

Mornye has sent word that her research is finally complete. After several twists and turns, the prototype of "Sylph" has finally been unveiled. Her brief message barely hides her excitement. To match the warmth and wonder of the New Solar Celebration, Luuk Herssen has baked a fresh batch of waffles. A message arrives at your Terminal riding a beam of sunlight—an invitation as soft as a waffle and as rich as a latte.\nIt's such a sunny day. While you have a moment, head to the infirmary to try Luuk Herssen's latest creation.

Based on your feedback, Luuk Herssen has refined his waffle recipe once more. Yet, the fresh batch vanished mysteriously just two minutes after he left! What kind of being could act so fast? To recover the stolen treats, Luuk Herssen has sent you a "commission." \nHead to the infirmary and begin your investigation into this Case of the Missing Waffles.

In the final stage of your detective game, you have deduced the identity of the thief who made off with the waffles in under two minutes, but the important waffles remain gone. Where would a tiny feline suspect hide its spoils? \n"A place not far from here, quiet, undisturbed."\nFollowing this lead, head to the preparation team's warehouse with Luuk Herssen.

Luuk Herssen messages you that while he was relaxing at the celebration and scouting for potential adopters, the kitten got spooked and slipped out of its cage. \nA "criminal" like this cannot be allowed to roam free! For the safety of waffles everywhere, head to the teaching building, track down this fluffy fugitive, and bring it back to the infirmary.

With the New Solar Celebration concluded, Luuk Herssen has stayed true to his word and taken a well-earned vacation. Head to the Infirmary to catch up with Luuk Herssen.

Sigrika is practicing tirelessly at the training grounds, striving to sketch every rune with absolute precision. \nThe weight of everyone's expectations propels her forward, but her nerves have stretched thin, tense as a bowstring pushed past its limit. Sigrika leads you to a certain rooftop within the Academy. To any passerby, it looks completely ordinary. Spotting them takes a sharp eye. She has one, undoubtedly. And so do you.

Sigrika sits in silence on the rooftop. 
The wind, which once brought her endless inspiration, now only brushes past her, stealing her warmth. Her heart of gold has grown heavy, each beat a soft whimper.
Please, stop crying out, she prays, but it is to no avail.

With the Dark Side crisis resolved, Sigrika is in higher spirits than ever before. Slowly, the tension starts to ebb, and her heart stops its soft whimpering.
The wind quiets down, and a bird lands gently at your side.

Sigrika returns to her room.
Her brilliant adventure in the Academy's Dark Side replays on a loop in her mind. Her cheeks burn with heat. Even after running several laps around her room, she can't get the temperature to drop.

With that thought, she opens the photo of the two of you. Her heart of gold, light once more, continues to dance with joy.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: You're back. Um... got any news about Sanna?

speaker: NPC #701041

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: ...Turns out she got tired of the stars here.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: It's strange. When I stargazed with her, I could always find something new in their constant, steady orbits.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: I guess I'm the only one who wants to keep staring at the same, unchanging night sky.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: …Sorry. I need some time alone. Thank you for helping.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Really? She wants to stay out in the frostlands a while longer to guide other teams...?

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: I see… Hah, she must've found something new that caught her eye!

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: That's just how Sanna is. She always forgets everything else when she's interested in something.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: But she promised me. We made a promise to stargaze together at the Spacetrek Observatory. So she'll come back eventually.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: I know I'll see her again one day, and that's something I'll look forward to...

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Just like the unchanging stars I look forward to seeing glide across Lahai-Roi's night sky...

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Thank you for asking around for me. I feel much better now.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: What will the stars look like tomorrow?

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: I see. So Sanna... she left.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: It's okay... I'm just a little confused.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Actually, I know that Sanna has always wanted to leave Lahai-Roi and see the world. She even asked me to go with her.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: But I always felt that... it was too dangerous.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Life as a researcher in Lahai-Roi is simple. My friendship with her is... was simple. From dawn till dusk, the days are predictable.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Should I leave Lahai-Roi too and go out into the world...?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sanna, do you want me to look for you?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Tomorrow's stars will be just as beautiful as ever...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Sanna, when will you come back and watch them with me?

speaker: NPC #701083
anh_en: I'm near the Spacetrek Observatory. Please help me...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: If only you were here, Sanna...

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Hello. I am Harriet, one of the researchers involved in the Spacetrek Observatory's reconstruction.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: You're {PlayerName}, right? Dhalifa told us about you.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That's me. Are you in trouble?

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Yes... I was just wondering what to do. Good thing you're here.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: As you know, the Spacetrek Observatory was once damaged by a Void Storm. Since then, we've set up multiple radar points to continue with our monitoring.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: This is one of them. Usually, we just needed to activate the Smartprint Cube to build a Void Storm monitoring radar.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: But… I didn't expect the Smartprint Cube that the Academy buried would be so much deeper than I had originally predicted.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: I'm having trouble operating it alone… Could you give me a hand?

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Great, the monitoring radar is now operational.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: That's true. But… this way is safer. More stable. More predictable, right?

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: You can look up at the sky knowing exactly what you'll see, without worrying about clouds blocking the stars…

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: I feel safe knowing that I'll always get to see it, and that there's always something I can look forward to.
That's a bit weird to say, isn't it?

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Right? I knew you'd understand the need to avoid feeling anxious.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Really...? Sorry, maybe I'm just prone to worrying...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Why isn't Sanna with you today?

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Sanna recently went to the frostlands with my senior, Jasper. She was born in the Roya Frostlands, so she knows the terrain really well.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Jasper's expedition needed guides to lead them to survey the Exoswarm there... I hope they come back soon.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: ...This was all thanks to you. You're just like Sanna with her innate, keen intuition for using machines.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: I do feel a little lonely. But like I said, knowing I'll see her again someday makes it easier to bear.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: I'm going back to the Spacetrek Observatory to wait for Sanna now. Thank you for your help.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I heard you mention that name earlier. A friend of yours?

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Yes, she's a Roya with a penchant for mathematics. We are... very good friends.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: We usually spend all our time together.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Whenever I run into trouble, she helps me out. And at night, we look at the stars together.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: …She's always there for me. That's why I applied for the restoration work, because that's where you can see the clearest, brightest stars.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: I wanted to bring her to the Spacetrek Observatory to stargaze together, to pay her back. We made a promise.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I recall the stars in Lahai-Roi's underground are projected by a simulator.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I hope we can complete the Spacetrek Observatory's restoration before she comes back...

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Why isn't she still back yet...?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Harriet, what's wrong? You don't look well.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: Ah, it's you. I... am fine. It's just that...

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: …Sanna hasn't replied to my messages for days.

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: I heard from the crew at the Starward Riseway that the blizzards and Void Storms out in the frostlands have been terrible lately...

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: If you can, could you please go there again and ask for more information for me?

speaker: NPC #701041
anh_en: I've already gone a few times... and I still have work to finish at the Spacetrek Observatory...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Among the crowd at the station, you find a group of researchers dusting snow from their protective suits.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: No, not what you're thinking. She didn't have an accident out there. It's worse than that.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: He lets out a heavy sigh.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: Sanna... is a very lively and adventurous Roya girl. Clever with her hands, too.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: As for Harriet, you've met her too. She's very dependent on Sanna, and Sanna is good to her, but... I think they want different things.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: Sanna craves change and thrill. And Harriet… she needs something steady.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: During this Exoswarm expedition, the Institute made some real breakthroughs. We found several rare Exoswarm.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: But then, when nobody was expecting it… Sanna colluded with outside poachers. She helped them smuggle the Exoswarm out.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: …I chased after them. Only caught their trail as they were leaving. Sanna shouted back to me through the snow, saying she was going to see the stars somewhere else. Told me to tell Harriet that she was a bad person.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: I couldn't tell if the look on her face was excitement or misery. The snow was too thick… I just couldn't see.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: I should've shot to stop them, but I hesitated and missed my chance. The blizzard covered their tracks not long after.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: ...That's the whole story. Whether you want to tell Harriet or not is up to you.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Why don't you tell her yourself? You're a respected senior to her.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: Because I don't know if Harriet actually wants to hear this. Maybe she'd be happier thinking Sanna's still out there roaming the frostlands.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: I already misjudged Sanna's character. I let my emotions get in the way when I should've fired. I'm too close to this to see clearly, and I don't want to make a third mistake.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: ...Ugh, I need a drink. As for Harriet, I'll leave her to you.

speaker: NPC #701042
anh_en: ...Sanna? Did Harriet ask you to come?

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: Ha. I'm Jasper. Harriet might've mentioned me.
She said you were her senior.
She said Sanna went to the frostlands with you.

speaker: NPC #701043
anh_en: Heh… Yeah. They actually met through a research project I led a while back.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: ...I used to choose nights like this for my missions. The rain would wash everything away. The burden, the numbness, the things I'm not proud of. But now... the rain just sounds like music.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Feel free to drive with confidence. I'll be monitoring the readings to ensure a safe and efficient arrival.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Wind resistance, stable. Lighting conditions, optimal. However... I observe tension build-up in the muscles around your neck and shoulders. Would you like to relax for a bit?

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: The Research Institute is located above the rain clouds. I haven't seen such rain in a long time.

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: I wish this journey would last a bit longer...

speaker: NPC #100099
anh_en: Be mindful of the extended braking distances in poor weather conditions, and... Ah-Achoo! Body temperature drop detected...

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: Alright, time to go. Let the wind bear witness to a new beginning.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: Hey, look up. It's been a while since we've had such beautiful sunlight, hasn't it?

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: The pitter-pattering of the rain sounds like drumbeats... Want me to hum along?

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: The wind tonight's neither salty nor sweet, just right for forgetting the things best left behind.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: All systems, check. Engine parameters, check.... Off we go. Just like in Honami.

speaker: NPC #150065
anh_en: How odd... The darker the rainy night, the clearer everything seems.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Alright, let Lahai-Roi's Top Biker see how you handle the ride!

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: How about I hack into the bike's system and turn off the speed limiter? What's that? Follow traffic rules? You got it!

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: You can use my mech "feathers" to block the rain. I can keep up with your speed after I transform.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: The sea of stars… it's breathtaking, yet every time I look at it, I'm filled with such mixed emotions.

speaker: NPC #150059
anh_en: Humans are like raindrops—we fall and scatter in the dark, hoping to one day flow into the same ocean of frequencies.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Going together? I mean... Thank you so much, Senior! Alright, let's hit the road!

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Oh, the sunshine on our faces...

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Within the runes, a drop is rain. And rain is a tear. I wonder... who is crying right now, and why?

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: Every rune is a fallen star. Because... within those stars lie the universe's True Name.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: At times like this, it's hard to keep my eyes on the road. They keep drifting toward the horizon.

speaker: NPC #150088
anh_en: People in the desert seek the rain, just as we seek the stars.

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: We're going for a ride? That's great. Can I pick the music?

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: Can't this thing go any faster? Huh? So your bike has a speed limit too...

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: That was a huge splash! We could've ruined someone's day.

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: Aleph-1 will return someday... But I will not lose...

speaker: NPC #200144
anh_en: It's too quiet out here. Crack a joke for me?

speaker: NPC #200138
anh_en: Press on. I will guard your rear.

speaker: NPC #200138
anh_en: Let the rain fall. It's a sign of good fortune. Only take care not to catch a cold.

speaker: NPC #200138
anh_en: How might the stars and moon above perceive those who roam the earth below?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Ugh... I really don't look forward to fixing my hair later.

speaker: NPC #200138
anh_en: Rainy nights like this stir old memories. I remember how raindrops slid along my blade, as though the traces of my past were being washed away.

speaker: NPC #300073
anh_en: Want me to tweak the motorbike's parameters? ...I'm kidding, chill... Don't gotta stare daggers.

speaker: NPC #300073
anh_en: Can we swap seats? Wanna feel the wind, too.

speaker: NPC #300073
anh_en: This rain... I hear the weather in Lahai-Roi can be controlled. That true?

speaker: NPC #300073
anh_en: The stars are almost close enough to touch... Beautiful.

speaker: NPC #300073
anh_en: Shame we can't see the stars.

speaker: NPC #300072
anh_en: WOOO! Punch it! Don't you dare slow down!

speaker: NPC #300072
anh_en: Sun's never felt the same since I got chromed up, but hell... This feels great!

speaker: NPC #300072
anh_en: We're chill. Little rain like this won't rust my chrome.

speaker: NPC #300072
anh_en: Whoa, check the sky!… Is that a constellation?! It totally looks like Cup-Cup's face! Hah!

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: If only there were shooting stars tonight...

speaker: NPC #300072
anh_en: Whoa there, choom. Eaaasy... Known a few gonks who totaled their rides on wet nights like this!

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: You... do have a driver's license, right?

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Oops, almost lost my hat there.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Raindrops pattering against my skin... Mmm, feels strangely wonderful.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Look at that constellation. It holds a very special meaning in Royan culture...

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: You must be freezing in this wind. Here, how about I shield you?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Hah... I didn't expect to feel so calm driving through a rainy night.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: So, where to this time? ...Nah, don't tell me. Not knowing is half the fun.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: Achoo... Heh, I'm fine. Your hair just tickled me there for a sec.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: We should find cover! You're getting soaked! If not...  just duck under my jacket with me. It's big enough for two.

speaker: NPC #100085
anh_en: All those fallen "stars"... where do you think they end up?

Ludens has volunteered to promote Peaks of Prestige, aiming to introduce the game to a wider audience.
Agrippa the Ironheart, Septimont's renowned blacksmith, now accepts your challenge as a Lord of Prestige.
I shall dedicate all my victories to Liliania!
I am Liliania the Splendent. Do come and enjoy my performance!
Marcia the Lifespring's healing treatments have returned countless Gladiators back into the arena.
A Gladiator from House Grandino, willing to betray his partners to prove his worth.
The manager of House Grandino, a shrewd man always preaching "Total Cost and Efficiency Management," making him the most hated figure among Gladiators.
The Domino of House Grandino. He knows absolutely nothing about duels or the Peaks of Prestige, except, of course, that it's a very profitable venture.
Raul the Dustbound once swore to fight for glory, just like the other Gladiators. What, then, twisted his ideals?
A man with strange behavior, seemingly obsessed with finding something.
A hot-tempered woman who appears to be troubled by something.
A quiet, reserved old man. Perhaps only one thing can unlock the heart he keeps sealed.

Gallus the Nightmare may be a genius, yet even geniuses have problems they can't solve.\n\nGallus's Tactics: Increase Base HP to 45. Gallus draws 2 additional cards during the deployment stage each round.
An elated Duelist whose joyous expression seems fueled by the thrill of the duel itself.
An arrogant Duelist who has never faced a worthy opponent and is convinced of his own invincibility.
A contemplative Duelist who is constantly troubled by conflicting thoughts.

Furius the Firebrand, the Conqueror of Prestige and the creator of this game, is the ultimate challenge that Duelists must face before reaching the pinnacle of glory.\n\nFurius's Tactics: Increase Base HP to 50. Draw 8 cards of his choice and gain 6 extra Energy at the start of the first round.
The Captian always wins, because fortune always smiles on him!
For Ciaccona, Peaks of Prestige could also be a kind of musical instrument.
Glory isn't only won in the arena, and Lupa knows this well. That's why she'll fight until the very last moment.
Calcharo, head of the Ghost Hounds, hereby challenges you to a duel.
Challenge other Duelists and prove your unmatched power!

Challenge elite Duelists and prove your unmatched strength!\n\nElite Duelist's Tactics: Increase Base HP to 45. At the start of the Deployment Stage, Elite Duelist draws one more card. Elite Duelist's Echoes have their STR and CON increased by 2 in this duel.
Danvers's deep enthusiasm for Peaks of Prestige has inspired many retired Gladiators to give the game a try.
Fulvia's got too much work on her plate and barely any time left for duels.
Furius is busy handling all sorts of investors, but he can never resist a good duel.
Raul has lost his ticket to freedom and is once again bound by the chains of reality.
Your attention, everyone! This star is ready to dazzle again!
No more bitter pills for me… I've got to win this time!

Ashild is worried about the fate of the fan club. Although she places great trust in the fan club's leader, Anita, she still sees no hope of defeating the professors from any of the members up until now.
Professor Dennis believes that the fan club members' duels lack the necessary elegance and artistic beauty. He is now committed to reshaping it all based on his own ideal.
Professor Festa believes she has found the perfect algorithm for dueling—one that would make her undefeated under any scenario. However, there are always variables that algorithms cannot predict.
Chessa has no interest in dueling, and cares little about the fan club's future. To her, destroying the fan club is just an unavoidable extra work in her normal, boring job.

Professor Calith sees Furius, the founder of Peaks of Prestige, as his archenemy. His campaign to disband the fan club might stem from a desire to shield his students from following… or it might be fueled by pure, personal animosity.
Anita, the Division Manager for the Peaks of Prestige Lahai-Roi Ranked Tournament, challenges you to a duel.
To Aya, Peaks of Prestige is a way to relieve stress from her schoolwork and an indispensable part of her life.
Do mech nurses use electric combos? Stay tuned right here on Peaks of Prestige!
Looks like I.R.I.S. might have switched to a strange but familiar personality. It's a bit concerning... but let's duel first.
When Zahira brought Peaks of Prestige from the Academy to her Roya tribe, she never imagined it would sweep through Bjartr Woods like wildfire.
Lagerith has been pursuing power to protect something precious to her. Now, Peaks of Prestige seems to have become one of her sources of power.
Katrina wants to leave Lahai-Roi and become a Septimont Gladiator... Perhaps one day her dreams will come true.
Challenge Jonna! Let her see who's the real Duelist!
Great! Finally, someone has come to challenge Eyvind!
Do Soliskin also play Peaks of Prestige? Or are they just acting as Eloni's tactical disguise?
Odgier heeds the calling from deep within his heart. Alone, he pursues the Exoswarm in the wilderness, hoping to gain wild wisdom from them.
Come, let's settle this once and for all.
Aldo takes great interest in the ancient creatures of Lahai-Roi and has implemented his imagination of them in his deck.
Italo is an exchange student from Ragunna. Despite having seen the technological wonders of Lahai-Roi, he still believes that nothing is stronger than an Echo.
Andrius is the technician and logistics coordinator for his research expedition team. However, people who know him say he's not particularly reliable.
Luanquan realized that she had left a crucial item behind on the way to the frostlands. This mistake cast a shadow over her scientific expedition.
As a Roya, Lana is particularly interested in Startorch Academy's expedition motorbikes. A certain rumor led her to come up with a rather crazy idea…
Joanna is currently responsible for data collection in the Roya Frostlands. The job is monotonous, and she desperately needs a strong opponent to kill time.
Ursula ventured into the harsh Roya Frostlands in search of a strong opponent. Perhaps here, she will find honor and joy.
The Roya believe that the best food is only found in the harshest environments. Bream is no exception.
Gilson has been watching over the slumbering Exostrider. With the rise of the new sun over Lahai-Roi, he knows his watch is coming to an end.
Varr is brainstorming ideas for an interesting novel. His inspiration mainly seems to come from the legend of the Exostrider.
There is a record in the Spacetrek Collective's database of a crashed spacecraft that hides a treasure with the power of the cosmos. This is what drew Wilhelmina here.
Garcia is waiting for supplies, and before they arrive, he decides to do something to pass the time.
John heard rumors at the Academy that an ancient secret is hidden in the frostlands. And now, it is time for the truth to be revealed.
Do Tard-E Units dream of electric decks?

The basic unique abilities of cards. Special Effects generally remain in effect for the duration of the duel or can be triggered after meeting certain conditions.
Echoes with Transform take effect when dragged into the Transform area. Normally, Transformed cards are not returned to your deck, but are destroyed in this duel instead.
Performing certain actions or triggering skills grants one stack of Recharge. Accumulating certain stacks of Recharge triggers Overburst automatically.
Unique abilities that can be used after meeting certain conditions. Active Skills can only be used once per round. Some effects can reset the card's Active Skill Uses.
Domain is a new card category added to the Lahai-Roi version of Peaks of Prestige. These cards possess extremely powerful abilities that can shift the tide of any duel.
Quick-Deploy refers to deploying an Echo without playing it from your hand at the standard Energy cost. These special deployments count as Quick-Deploys and can activate certain card abilities.

Novelty is a new card category added to the Lahai-Roi version of Peaks of Prestige. They are items with unique powers. Novelties do not directly participate in the Battle Stage like Echoes, but instead influence the battlefield through their unique abilities.
The number of rounds the Novelty can endure after being deployed. The Novelty is returned to the deck at the end of its duration.
The uses of the Novelty's Active Skill. The Novelty is returned to the deck after uses are depleted.

Placing cards from the Deployment Zone or your hand into the Reconstruction Zone shuffles it back into your deck. In the Lahai-Roi version of Peaks of Prestige, Reconstruction does not grant energy, but can still trigger Reconstruction-related card skills.
Unique abilities that can only be used once per round. However, some cards with Reset effects can reset the uses of a card's Active Skill.

- Modulation allows Echoes to Activate powerful abilities.\n- Special Skills are Unactivated when Echoes are first Deployed and need to be Activated.\n- Modulation Activates the Special Skills of the Modulated Echo.

- In this stage, you can Deploy, Modulate, or Transform an Echo. You may also drag the Echo to the Reconstruction Area to recover Energy.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} "Fight!" to finish this stage.
- A stage where Echoes fight against each other.\n- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} "Fight!" to enter this stage.

Some junk scavenged from the ruins. A few pieces don't even look like they're from this era. Nonetheless, they'd still come in handy when the End Times roll around.

A dairy product that's been sitting around for who knows how long. Surprisingly, you can still drink it.\n"The trick is to ignore the use-by date and try to bypass your tongue. If all goes well, you may still fool your bowel."
A hardy herb that somehow survived the End Times. Can be used to stop bleeding in a pinch.\n"Chew it up, slap it on the wound. Good enough."

This little talon used to be a good luck charm. When the End Times came, even the slightest stroke of luck became a lifeline for survivors.\n"If I could go back in time, I'd definitely use this thing to pray for a windfall. But now? What good's a mountain of Shell Credits?"

A small pendant shaped like a Goldcrest Scarab. Maybe it'll bring you some fortune.\n"Fortune...? Or, put it more plainly, a better chance of finding supplies. Well, you can always sell it for some food on your worst days. So—you taking it or not?"
Leaftail Foxes have a habit of stashing Oaknuts around their dens. For survivors, that little quirk makes Oaknuts a good sign that supplies might be nearby.\n"They're not bad as a snack, you know."
A stray KU-Roro that lost contact with the Black Shores and has been wandering alone ever since. Once it finds out who you are, it decides to lend you a hand.\n"KU-Roro unit, at your service!"

You can't tell what model this mech is, but you can tell it's stuffed with explosives, ready to blow itself up the moment it detects a threat.\n"It's got legs, but we've forgotten how to make 'em work... Eh, whatever. It'll still come in handy."
An oven Echo from Rinascita. Even in this post-apocalyptic world, it's still doing what it does best—cooking up all kinds of delicious treats.\n"Yummy yummy. That's the Bakie I know."

No one remembers what this spray was originally for anymore. These days, people just use it however they see fit, giving it all kinds of new purposes.\n"Looks pretty spicy. You think we can use it for hotpot?"

No one remembers what this spray was originally for anymore. These days, people just use it however they see fit, giving it all kinds of new purposes.\n"Smells refreshing, at least... But more like detergent than a drink, don't you think?"
An encased explosive crystal that can be detonated multiple times.\n"Pick it up carefully, then throw it fast. Easy, right? Huh? What's this under my foot..."

An energy shield that still works well enough to provide the most basic protection to its user.\n"If TDs can level an entire city, why would anyone think they're perfectly safe behind a busted shield?"

It is said that this kind of ore was once used by swindlers as fake gold. When the End Times came, weapons and tools made from it became more popular than real gold.\n"You can even just chuck it at your enemies. Feels better than a plain old rock."

A type of edible mushroom. To survive sudden environmental changes, they evolved the ability to release a massive cloud of spores upon impact. Easy to grow and tough as nails, they've become a staple food for survivors.\n"Today's special: Stir-fried Mushrooms with Mushrooms, Mushroom Stew with Mushrooms, and a Mushroom Salad topped with Mushrooms..."

This butterfly is a symbol of luck. According to some legends, a mysterious world-saving organization would always show up on its wings to help survivors face the crisis.\n"It can be a sign, sure... Just don't go making a religion out of it..."

A KU-Roro equipped with a flamethrower. Used to be the barbecue enthusiast of the KU-Roro squad. Maybe.\n"Cremator sounds way more badass. And honestly, it fits what it's been up to these days... Anyway, by fire be purged, TDs!"
You can't tell what model this mech is, but you can tell it's more powerful than the usual Bomb Mechs.\n"Time to teach 'em some lessons!"
For some reason, Bakie has grown to a much larger size. Now it can pump out food even faster.\n"A bigger Bakie means more tasty food, I guess..."
The destiny it reveals is chaotic, but at least not hopeless.\n"I'm actually super good at these cubes, y'know. First we do this, then this... oops..."
A nut you found from an abandoned factory. It seems to be made of some unknown high-density metal.\n"I mean, what can this thing do? It's just a heavy nut. That's it."

A recorder that captured the status of automated assembly lines. And just like the lines it used to record, the tape inside keeps looping forever.\n"That tape never seems to end. Wait… how many times have we watched this already?
A highly portable compass. A must-have for exploring the city ruins.\n"Heard the poles shifted before. But until that happens again, this thing's still pretty handy."

Simulation: formidable abominations flood everything like a dark tide. You have no choice left but to make your final stand.\nWarning: Activating this protocol will significantly increase the difficulty of the drill.\n"Just wanna give a try, you know..."

No one remembers what this spray was originally for anymore. These days, people just use it however they see fit, giving it all kinds of new purposes.\n"Looks pretty spicy. You think we can use it for hotpot?"
No one remembers what this spray was originally for anymore. These days, people just use it however they see fit, giving it all kinds of new purposes.\n"It won't dye my tongue purple, right?"
Most survivors have forgotten its real name and original use. All they know is that it boosts the body and eases the pain.\n"Well, it is what it is. Want some candy?"
Most survivors have forgotten its real name and original use. All they know is that it boosts the body and eases the pain.\n"It tastes better than it looks. But honestly? Mid."

A type of Tacitite Bloom packed with highly volatile energy. The energy it emits can enhance weapons, but it might also pose a risk to whoever carries it.\n"Keep hauling that live hazard around, and we're gonna have to politely ask you to leave the squad. Just drop it. For our sake, alright?"

A pair of goggles with a built-in aiming assist system. But since they're a bit damaged, they could be slow at locking onto nearby targets.\n"Look over there. Look over here. Over there. Over here... Wait, my head's spinning..."
A spring that stores the force applied to it. Inside, the pressure builds and releases.\n"Might've been a kid's toy back in the day. But these days... just look at this thing go..."

A pair of high-tech gauntlets with a protective energy field that can also help you deliver a heavier punch in addition to shielding you.\n"Both a spear and a shield. Looks sci-fi enough... Now that's the good stuff."

Purple coral with a faint fluorescent glow. Its fractures are razor-sharp, making it a great material for barriers.\n"A recipe from some forgotten age says it's edible. I tried it. Let's just say my teeth weren't on board."
A golden-colored frog. Legends say it was a symbol of wealth in the past.\n"They jump fast. Traps are your best bet."
A piece of petrified remains from some unknown beast.\n"Good enough as a weapon."
KU-Roro units designed for rescue operations. Compared to stray KU-Roros, they are packed with more powerful arms and a whole lot more ammo.\n"KU-Roro units, ready for battle!"

A data chip containing an emergency override that rewrites the preprogrammed routines of all KU-Roros. Once activated, they'll stop active firing and start hauling explosives to defend key positions. The command cannot be reversed.\n"Order received! Time to blow those TDs to bits!"

This trinket is so precious that even in this post-apocalyptic age—when money means nothing—some are still willing to give everything to get their hands on it.\n"Trade it for some cans and treat yourself to a decent meal, alright?"
A crystal that enhances Resonance Ability. No one knows where it came from.\n"You see, everything's got its use. Food, weapon, or trade goods. But this thing? No clue what to do with it."
A fragile plant, as fleeting as a passing moment. Survivors make wishes with it, hoping the wind will carry its seeds, and their hopes, somewhere far away.\n"Just blow on it."
A type of small shrimp capable of warp-leaping for a short distance. Fragile as they are, they always manage to blink their way out of danger.\n"Shrimp! They'll make one hell of a meal!"

When smashed, this type of snail shell attracts TDs. Some veteran survivors use it to lure the TDs away while they raid the ruins for supplies.\n"Just never throw it directly at a TD. It won't do a thing. Just makes 'em angry."
Sliced butter blocks perfect for quick energy replenishment.\n"Have it with something else, or it might kill your appetite."

No one remembers what this spray was originally for anymore. These days, people just use it however they see fit, giving it all kinds of new purposes.\n"The previous owner told me it could make people invisible. Clearly, it didn't do the trick... which is why it's in my hand now."

Most survivors have forgotten its real name and original use. All they know is that it boosts the body and eases the pain.\n"The candy looks like a grape, smells like a grape, but tastes like orange... isn't it a bit weird?"\n"...Maybe it's simply out of date."
A large, sturdy shield. All the walls crumbled when the cataclysm struck. But humans have become the last bulwark of their own civilization.\n"I am not surrendering our future to you."
A censer loaded with explosives, so now it's literally a bomb.\n"Who the hell packed this thing with explosives..."
A rare type of slough. It symbolizes the chance to trade everything you have for a new kind of power.\n"This is insect slough.. Do we have to eat it?"

A prosthetic hand with a built-in set of weapons. The complex design makes it to use alongside other weapons.\n"Okay. So I press this button for 'Monoblade,' this one for 'Storm Drill.' Press them together for 'Cuttin' My Own Fingers Off'... Cool. I've memorized 'em all."

A survival knife that looks pretty ordinary, but seems to carry some kind of peculiar power.\n"Great for outdoor survival and fighting off TDs. As long as you've got enough whetstones on you, that is."
Wings issued to mech soldiers. They provide a moderate boost to both movement speed and defense.\n"I can fly! Hahaha, look, I'm flying—"

An automatic injector loaded with cardiotonics. Sure, a heavy dose of heart stimulants is never a good idea, but it beats facing TDs without a boost and getting torn apart.\n"This is no boxing ring. You'd better bounce right back the second you hit the ground. No referee's there to count to ten for you."

A book filled with delirious heresies. The overflowing obsession with immortality in the text could easily get hold of the readers, turning them into predators who devour others' frequencies.\n"Just don't read it. And tell me at once if you've already read it... I'll figure something out."
A very heavy slammer. It smashes TDs like driving nails.\n"What's that saying again? When all you've got is a hammer..."
Sing with me—Sing with me at the End Times!\n"—One, no, two octaves higher!"
